svg.title: Avondale and surrounding ZIP Code Tabulation Areas
svg.desc: The tract-aligned Avondale neighborhood crosses six ZIP Code Tabulation Areas. The commonly used 45229 ZCTA extends north beyond Avondale, while western, eastern, and southern parts of Avondale fall in five other ZCTAs. A table compares Avondale with ZCTA 45229: 43 versus 36 percent living in poverty, 20,000 versus 31,000 dollars median household income, and 78 versus 65 percent Black non-Hispanic or Latino population.
